environments.name: Space station (ISS)
environments.escalation: Contact the flight surgeon in Mission Control now.

environments.name: Moon
environments.blackoutNote: No direct link to Earth from the far side and parts of the South Pole.
environments.timeToCare: Return to Earth in 72 to 144 h
environments.careLead: Crew, with the flight surgeon when linked
environments.escalation: Call the flight surgeon if linked; if not, act now.

environments.name: Mars transit
environments.blackoutNote: About 2 to 3 weeks of disrupted contact at solar conjunction, every 26 months or so.
environments.escalation: Act now with the crew medical officer; tell Earth after.

environments.name: Mars surface
environments.blackoutNote: No line of sight to Earth for about 12 h a day, plus solar conjunction.
environments.escalation: Act now with the crew medical officer; queue a message for Earth.

environments.name: Remote Earth station (Concordia, winter)
environments.blackoutNote: Satellite phone and internet are the only links.
environments.timeToCare: No evacuation for about 9 months of winter
